scope: External cross-check of five remaining null-race CaC-usable skills; no canonical mutation without explicit race/gender eligibility wording.

records.name: Android Kick
records.finding: External references identify Android Kick as Mira's Super Skill and list it among techniques used by the Future Warrior, but no explicit Future Warrior race/gender restriction was found in the reviewed material.

records.name: Armored Boost
records.finding: The Future Warrior technique list explicitly lists Armored Boost as GT Trunks' Evasive Skill and separately marks some other skills with explicit race restrictions; the reviewed entry does not provide an explicit Armored Boost race/gender restriction.

records.name: Burning Spin
records.finding: The Future Warrior technique list identifies Burning Spin as Nuova Shenron's Ultimate Skill, but the reviewed material does not establish a specific CaC race/gender restriction.

records.name: Burning Strike
records.finding: Search evidence includes historical discussion of Burning Strike as a Trunks skill and a separate PC mod that explicitly makes it usable by all races; the mod is not authoritative evidence for the retail game's eligibility, so no retail race restriction is promoted.

records.name: Burst Attack
records.finding: The Future Warrior technique list identifies Burst Attack as Nuova Shenron's Super Skill, but no explicit CaC race/gender restriction was established in the reviewed material.

validation.rule: Character ownership, Future Warrior usability, and modded all-race behavior are not by themselves sufficient to populate a restrictive race/gender value.

next: Continue the remaining null race-restriction frontier, prioritizing direct retail-game eligibility wording.
